audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows needed the inverse of the mirror's flip: Level 3 and Level 6 read Skill, and 2+ items read Darius while whys[6] says 'You out-scale him here'.
audit.why: The mirror audit flipped win[2]/phases[2] to Darius 6.5/10, win[4] to Darius, and win[6]/phases[6] to K'Sante 4/10, and explicitly noted that ksante.full.js needs the inverse.
audit.corrected: Level 3 and Level 6 set to Darius at 3.5/10, 2+ items set to K'Sante at 6/10, in both layers, with phases[2].why and phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracked Apprehend everywhere without ever giving its cooldown, and the 2-item spike was described from Darius's side.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s — the longest gap in the lane and the whole reason levels 4-5 are playable. Decimate is 9s and heals off the blade half; Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80 and refreshes on a kill.
audit.corrected: 26s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and tradeGood; phases[6].why now states what two items buys you.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Q3-knockup' again (Ntofo Strikes pulls at two stacks), and the don'ts were generic filler that never said what five Hemorrhage stacks actually do.
audit.why: At five stacks Darius enrages for massive AD and Guillotine's true damage is at maximum — and true damage means the armour you built does nothing. That is the reason not to fight there, and the page never gave it.
audit.corrected: Two-stack pull in tradeGood; Hemorrhage's five stacks and Guillotine's true damage written into dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d; Decimate's heal noted so the Grievous Wounds line in report[8] has a reason.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your combo is online but his level-3 all-in still out-trades it — spend W on his Apprehend, not on a duel you lose.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: you survive Noxian Guillotine and keep swinging, and R peels him off your carries. His bully window is gone.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Q3-peel after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — his whole all-in starts there, so fight only after it. - Decimate: 9s, and the blade half heals him. - Hemorrhage: 5 stacks feed Guillotine. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: His all-in start. Q3-peel after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that gap is your entire trading window.

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Darius, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: Chain Q slows on Darius, two stacks to pull him in while Apprehend's 26s runs, W through the bleed, then peel out or All Out.

edits.before: That is Darius's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Five Hemorrhage stacks enrage him and max out Guillotine's true damage.

edits.before: Going All Out into his peel window — shredding your own resists at the wrong time is how K’Sante ints.
edits.after: At five stacks his Guillotine is true damage — your resists do not reduce a single point of it.

notes: Chart flipped as the inverse of the mirror's group (rows 3, 6 to Darius; 2+ items to K'Sante), which also repairs the win[6]-vs-whys[6] contradiction where the chart said Darius while the text said you out-scale him. First item still reads Darius on both layers while whys[5] calls it skill-dependent and the packet says Skill — the mirror did not touch that row, so I left it rather than open a cross-page disagreement; it is in questionsForUser. 'W's unstoppable charge' persists in wants.you[0], early and spikes[1]: Riot's text says charge-up damage reduction, not unstoppable, so UNVERIFIED and untouched.
